    ScopeSchemaUrl String CODEC(ZSTD({p7:Int64})),
    ServiceName LowCardinality(String) CODEC(ZSTD({p8:Int64})),
    MetricName String CODEC(ZSTD({p9:Int64})),
    MetricDescription String CODEC(ZSTD({p10:Int64})),
    MetricUnit String CODEC(ZSTD({p11:Int64})),
    Attributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String) CODEC(ZSTD({p12:Int64})),
    StartTimeUnix DateTime64(9) CODEC(Delta, ZSTD({p13:Int64})),
    TimeUnix DateTime64(9) CODEC(Delta, ZSTD({p14:Int64})),
    Count UInt64 CODEC(Delta, ZSTD({p15:Int64})),
    Sum Float64 CODEC(ZSTD({p16:Int64})),
    Scale Int32 CODEC(ZSTD({p17:Int64})),
    ZeroCount UInt64 CODEC(ZSTD({p18:Int64})),
    PositiveOffset Int32 CODEC(ZSTD({p19:Int64})),
    PositiveBucketCounts Array(UInt64) CODEC(ZSTD({p20:Int64})),
    NegativeOffset Int32 CODEC(ZSTD({p21:Int64})),
    NegativeBucketCounts Array(UInt64) CODEC(ZSTD({p22:Int64})),
    Exemplars Nested (
        FilteredAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String),
        TimeUnix DateTime64(9),
        Value Float64,
        SpanId String,
        TraceId String
    ) CODEC(ZSTD({p23:Int64})),
    Flags UInt32  CODEC(ZSTD({p24:Int64})),
    Min Float64 CODEC(ZSTD({p25:Int64})),
    Max Float64 CODEC(ZSTD({p26:Int64})),
    AggregationTemporality Int32 CODEC(ZSTD({p27:Int64})),
    INDEX idx_res_attr_key mapKeys(ResourceAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p28:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p29:Int64},
    INDEX idx_res_attr_value mapValues(ResourceAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p30:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p31:Int64},
    INDEX idx_scope_attr_key mapKeys(ScopeAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p32:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p33:Int64},
    INDEX idx_scope_attr_value mapValues(ScopeAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p34:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p35:Int64},
    INDEX idx_attr_key mapKeys(Attributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p36:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p37:Int64},
    INDEX idx_attr_value mapValues(Attributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p38:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p39:Int64}
    ) ENGINE = MergeTree()
    TTL toDateTime(TimeUnix) + toIntervalDay({p40:Int64})
    PARTITION BY toDate(TimeUnix)
    ORDER BY (ServiceName, MetricName, Attributes, toUnixTimestamp64Nano(TimeUnix))
    SETTINGS index_granularity={p41:Int64}, ttl_only_drop_parts = {p42:Int64}

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "default"."otel_traces"  (

    SpanId String CODEC(ZSTD({p3:Int64})),

    ScopeName String CODEC(ZSTD({p10:Int64})),
    ScopeVersion String CODEC(ZSTD({p11:Int64})),
    SpanAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String) CODEC(ZSTD({p12:Int64})),

        Name LowCardinality(String),
        Attributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String)

        TraceId String,
        SpanId String,
        TraceState String,
        Attributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String)

AS SELECT
              TraceId,
              min(Timestamp) as Start,
              max(Timestamp) as End
   FROM "default"."otel_traces"
   WHERE TraceId != {p1:String}
   GROUP BY TraceId

q:e17e838f-bbcd-4a10-91d2-8bdfabe4b351.query: SELECT Timestamp, ServiceName, SeverityText, Body FROM default.otel_logs WHERE ((Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(_CAST({p1:Int64}, {p2:String}))) AND (Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(_CAST({p3:Int64}, {p4:String})))) AND ((toStartOfFiveMinutes(Timestamp) >= toStartOfFiveMinutes(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(_CAST({p5:Int64}, {p6:String})))) AND (toStartOfFiveMinutes(Timestamp) <= toStartOfFiveMinutes(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(_CAST({p7:Int64}, {p8:String}))))) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT _CAST({p9:Int64}, {p10:String}), _CAST({p11:Int64}, {p12:String}) FORMAT JSON

q:e6ccf342-ffa9-4e46-9419-d7a3cf2a11ec.query: SELECT MAX(toFloat64OrDefault(toString(Duration))) AS series_0, SpanName, toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(Timestamp), toIntervalMinute({p1:Int64})) AS __hdx_time_bucket FROM default.otel_traces WHERE ((Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(_CAST({p2:Int64}, {p3:String}))) AND (Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(_CAST({p4:Int64}, {p5:String})))) GROUP BY SpanName, toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(Timestamp), toIntervalMinute({p6:Int64})) AS __hdx_time_bucket ORDER BY toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(Timestamp), toIntervalMinute({p7:Int64})) AS __hdx_time_bucket ASC FORMAT JSON

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "default"."otel_metrics_sum"  (
                                     ResourceAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String) CODEC(ZSTD({p1:Int64})),
    ResourceSchemaUrl String CODEC(ZSTD({p2:Int64})),
    ScopeName String CODEC(ZSTD({p3:Int64})),
    ScopeVersion String CODEC(ZSTD({p4:Int64})),
    ScopeAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String) CODEC(ZSTD({p5:Int64})),
    ScopeDroppedAttrCount UInt32 CODEC(ZSTD({p6:Int64})),
    ScopeSchemaUrl String CODEC(ZSTD({p7:Int64})),
    ServiceName LowCardinality(String) CODEC(ZSTD({p8:Int64})),
    MetricName String CODEC(ZSTD({p9:Int64})),
    MetricDescription String CODEC(ZSTD({p10:Int64})),
    MetricUnit String CODEC(ZSTD({p11:Int64})),
    Attributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String) CODEC(ZSTD({p12:Int64})),
    StartTimeUnix DateTime64(9) CODEC(Delta, ZSTD({p13:Int64})),
    TimeUnix DateTime64(9) CODEC(Delta, ZSTD({p14:Int64})),
    Value Float64 CODEC(ZSTD({p15:Int64})),
    Flags UInt32  CODEC(ZSTD({p16:Int64})),
    Exemplars Nested (
                         FilteredAttributes Map(LowCardinality(String), String),
    TimeUnix DateTime64(9),
    Value Float64,
    SpanId String,
    TraceId String
    ) CODEC(ZSTD({p17:Int64})),
    AggregationTemporality Int32 CODEC(ZSTD({p18:Int64})),
    IsMonotonic Boolean CODEC(Delta, ZSTD({p19:Int64})),
    INDEX idx_res_attr_key mapKeys(ResourceAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p20:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p21:Int64},
    INDEX idx_res_attr_value mapValues(ResourceAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p22:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p23:Int64},
    INDEX idx_scope_attr_key mapKeys(ScopeAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p24:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p25:Int64},
    INDEX idx_scope_attr_value mapValues(ScopeAttributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p26:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p27:Int64},
    INDEX idx_attr_key mapKeys(Attributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p28:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p29:Int64},
    INDEX idx_attr_value mapValues(Attributes) TYPE bloom_filter({p30:Float64}) GRANULARITY {p31:Int64}
    ) ENGINE = MergeTree()
    TTL toDateTime(TimeUnix) + toIntervalDay({p32:Int64})
    PARTITION BY toDate(TimeUnix)
    ORDER BY (ServiceName, MetricName, Attributes, toUnixTimestamp64Nano(TimeUnix))
    SETTINGS index_granularity={p33:Int64}, ttl_only_drop_parts = {p34:Int64}
